description: Get the full property schema of one or more node types: every property's key, type, options, default and whether it is required, plus input and output ports. Use it before writing a node's `data` so property names are exact rather than guessed. An unknown type comes back with an `error` entry instead of failing the call.

types.description: Exact type ids from list_node_types, e.g. ['webhook_trigger', 'if'].

name: get_node_schemas
title: Get node schemas
